browse_definitions.description: Walk several pages of a term's definitions and get them back as one list, which is how to answer 'everything Urban Dictionary has on this' without a loop. Pages are 10 definitions each and the step stops as soon as it reaches the end of the term, so a short term costs one request however high the page limit is set. It reports how many pages it read and whether it reached the end.

define_term.description: Look a slang term up and get a page of its definitions, each with the example sentence its author wrote, who wrote it and when. Urban Dictionary answers 10 at a time in its own ranking order, so the first one back is the definition the website shows first. Narrow the page by the date a definition was written, or reorder it oldest or newest first, to tell a term's new meaning from the one it had a decade ago. A term nobody has defined comes back empty rather than failing.

description: Look slang up in Urban Dictionary, the crowd-written dictionary the internet has been adding to since 1999. Define a term and get the example sentence its author wrote, browse every definition a term has, follow the slang its definitions link out to, or ask simply whether a word is defined at all, which is what a workflow reading chat messages usually needs. It also serves autocomplete suggestions, random definitions and the words of the day, plus the spoken audio and share images the site makes for every definition. No account or API key is required. Definitions are user-submitted and are often explicit.
